rejection_findings.finding: The phrase must still be known overstates claim 0070, which supports knowability or intelligibility rather than actual knowledge.

revisions.title: If the One is not
revisions.body: Within the negative hypothesis, ‘the One is not’ is not erasure: it treats the One as a determinate subject, knowable as what is meant and distinct from the Others. This does not assert actual knowledge or existence. It participates in being only as required for the statement to be true. Hence the paradox: changing from being to not-being, it moves; unable to travel or rotate, it rests, and so both alters and does not alter.
